mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary (itin_title, day_cnt, user_no, created_at, thumbnail) VALUES (#{itinTitle}, #{dayCnt}, #{userNo}, NOW(), #{thumbnail})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itinerary WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND is_deleted = false
SELECT i.itin_no AS itinNo, i.itin_title AS itinTitle, i.day_cnt AS dayCnt, i.thumbnail AS thumbnail FROM itinerary i WHERE i.user_no = #{userNo} AND i.itin_no = #{itinNo} AND i.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT ip.itin_place_no AS itinPlaceNo, ip.day_order AS dayOrder, ip.order_in_day AS orderInDay, ip.move_type AS moveType, ip.move_minutes AS moveMinutes,
ip.place_no AS placeNo, ip.itin_no AS itinNo,
p.content_id AS contentId, p.content_type_id AS contentTypeId, p.title AS title, p.addr1 AS addr1, p.addr2 AS addr2, p.description AS description, p.title_ko AS titleKo, p.addr1_ko AS addr1Ko, p.zipcode AS zipcode, p.opening AS opening, p.closing AS closing, p.rating AS rating, p.mapx AS mapx, p.mapy AS mapy, p.first_image AS firstImage, p.first_image2 AS firstImage2, p.tel AS tel, p.total_minutes AS totalMinutes FROM itinerary_place ip JOIN place p ON ip.place_no = p.place_no WHERE ip.itin_no = #{itinNo} ORDER BY ip.day_order, ip.order_in_day
